follow-up time: From diagnosis of gestational diabetes (GDM) to childbirth and postpartum
outcome: Persistence of impaired glucose tolerance after childbirth
finding: The metabolic characteristics of GDM women are reflected by OGTT values at diagnosis but are not associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: A greater prevalence of cesarean sections was observed in the group with both fasting and 1h and/or 2h BG values altered at OGTT diagnosis.
